messages: claire: Quick QA pass on Compliance screen — a few UX/a11y wording things. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/Compliance-Checklist omar: throw them in here and I'll pick up the small fixes. claire: 1) Label 'Data expiry' should be 'Retention period' — more discoverable for legal teams. mina: +1. Also prefer 'Retention period (days)' for the input label so auditors see the term 'retention'. claire: 2) When user toggles 'Indefinite' the days field stays editable. This confuses keyboard users. Recommend hiding the numeric input and showing a status chip 'Kept indefinitely'. drew: Implementation note: hide via aria-hidden and add an aria-live="polite" announcement 'Retention set to indefinite'. claire: 3) Region dropdown needs a short hint: 'Selected region affects where data is stored and may affect latency'. Make it aria-describedby. omar: I'll hook that up. Example: ... mina: 4) KMS badge copy: change from 'Customer key' to 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Add aria-label 'Encryption key: customer-managed (BYOK)'. drew: Also add a 'Key details' link that opens a drawer. When drawer opens move focus to heading, and trap focus. role=dialog + aria-modal. policy-bot: [policy] Reminder: audit exports must use UTC timestamps and header 'timestamp_utc'. See /policies/retention/export-format. claire: 5) Audit log timestamps in UI should append 'UTC' (e.g., 2026-03-01 12:00 UTC). We'll standardize across UI and CSV. omar: I'll make the small copy updates and file the frontend ticket for focus/aria changes today. mina: I'll update the figma strings and post the artboard. drew: I'll add the a11y acceptance criteria to the ticket (focus management, aria-live, aria-describedby). claire: Thanks — tagging @mina for copy, @drew for a11y signoff, @omar for implement. :thumbsup:
